messages:
Ibrahim Noor: Need quick help  applied for an expedited visa for a compliance-required customer visit. I paid the expedite fee   â¬120 via personal card and also did a pre-departure PCR test  â¬65 that the client asked for. Can I expense both and are there any approvals needed?

Lara (People Ops): Both are typically reimbursable when required by the client or travel policy. Short: submit both items, attach receipts, and include manager approval. Expedited visas > â¬100 normally need preapproval but retro approval is allowed if you couldn't get it beforehand.

Ibrahim Noor: I couldn't get preapproval because the client confirmed dates late. Evan approved the visit but I didn't loop him on the expedite fee.

Evan (Manager): Confirming I approved the visit and retro-approve the expedite visa fee and the PCR test. Please add a short note in the claim: "expedite and PCR required by Evan". :white_check_mark:

Monica (Accounting): When you submit, use categories: `visas` for the expedite fee and `medical-travel` for the PCR test. Upload the visa service invoice (must show fee line) and the lab certificate/receipt for the test.

Travel Bot: Reminder: if the visa invoice includes a non-refundable service component > â¬150 or includes third-party courier shipping, we require itemization.

Monica (Accounting): VAT note: visa service fees are usually non-recoverable. PCR tests may be VAT reclaimable only if the lab issues an invoice in company name. If you paid in foreign currency we'll use the card transaction rate for conversion; if cash, pick the expense date rate.

Lara (People Ops): Policy snippet: client-mandated travel requirements (tests, visas, immunizations) reimbursable when documented; attach receipts, add manager attestation for retro approvals, preapprove > â¬100 when possible. Link: <https://redwood.company/policies/expenses#health-visa>.

Ibrahim Noor: Thanks all  submitting now with Evan's note and receipts attached.

Monica (Accounting): Received  will process and flag visa as non-VAT reclaimable unless we get a company invoice. Will reach out if any docs missing.
